name: sql-developer-companion
description: Companion utilities for Oracle SQL Developer in VS Code

view/item/context.when: view == sqldeveloper.connections && (viewItem in sqldeveloper.tree.closedConnectionTypes || viewItem in sqldeveloper.tree.openConnectionTypes)
view == sqldeveloper.connections && (viewItem in sqldeveloper.tree.closedConnectionTypes || viewItem in sqldeveloper.tree.openConnectionTypes)

sqlDevCompanion.maxRecentItems.description: Maximum number of recent Oracle objects to remember

sqlDevCompanion.uriSchemes.description: URI schemes to track (leave empty to auto-detect Oracle schemes). Use this if auto-detection doesn't capture the right files.

enumDescriptions: Navigate to package body (.pkb) - shows implementation
Navigate to package spec (.pks) - shows interface/signature
Show both package body and spec as definition options
sqlDevCompanion.packageDefinitionTarget.description: Which package definition to navigate to when clicking on a package name or its procedures/functions

sqlDevCompanion.highlightExecutedStateme.description: Highlight the SQL statement in the editor when query results are displayed

enumDescriptions: No background color, only a colored left border
Use custom colors from highlightCustomBackground and highlightCustomBorder
sqlDevCompanion.highlightStyle.description: Style preset for the executed statement highlight

sqlDevCompanion.highlightCustomBackgroun.description: Custom background color for statement highlight (used when highlightStyle is 'custom'). Accepts any CSS color value.

sqlDevCompanion.highlightCustomBorder.description: Custom border color for statement highlight (used when highlightStyle is 'custom'). Accepts any CSS color value.

sqlDevCompanion.colorTitleBar.description: Apply connection colors to the title bar

sqlDevCompanion.colorActivityBar.description: Apply connection colors to the activity bar (left sidebar icons)

sqlDevCompanion.colorStatusBar.description: Apply connection colors to the status bar

enumDescriptions: Fill the entire status bar background with the connection color
Only show a colored border at the top of the status bar (less intrusive)
sqlDevCompanion.statusBarStyle.description: How to apply color to the status bar

sqlDevCompanion.recentObjectsOpenAsPrevi.description: Open recent objects in preview mode (italic tab title, replaced when opening another file). When false, files open as pinned editors.

sqlDevCompanion.connectionRules.description: Rules mapping connection names to badges and workspace colors. Set via right-click menu on connections.

connectionName.description: The connection name as defined in SQL Developer

badge.description: Short badge text (1-2 characters/emojis) to show on tab

workspaceColor.description: Hex color for workspace (title bar, activity bar, status bar). Example: '#FF5252'
